name: Acceptance suite-3 test 76 - exact Deny removes one prerequisite (regression)
note: IAM-1003 regression: all three primitives are granted on the role in one Allow, but an explicit Deny on iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy (same role) removes the trust-rewrite leg. With the trust-modify prerequisite suppressed there is NO full ROLE-TAKEOVER path and no TRUST-POLICY-MODIFY capability, but the remaining iam:PutRolePolicy capability is NOT hidden. The suppressed critical path must not be counted in the risk summary.
